vision.title:
Our vision for the future
of agriculture
vision.description: We believe agriculture should remain a human centric career that heals the planet and supports communities.

whoWeAre.missionStatement: We are creating generative farms, but will also consider our mission fulfilled if our work aids others to achieve this outcome.

competencies.title: Todd is differentiated by a combination of three core competencies.

items.1: Understanding of Modern Consumer Demands and Channels
items.2: Positioned at the Frontier of Sustainable Agriculture

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
responsibilities.subtitle: We work with self-supporting farms that value the Todd team’s ability to affect change in these areas.

0.heading: Disciplined Data Selection
0.description: We utilize proprietary analytic frameworks and digital capabilities to understand disease dynamics and insect mitigation holistically, enabling responsible farm management decisions.

1.heading: Company Philosophy
1.description: We are assembling a firm designed to emulate the consumer bases of our farms, embracing a holistic pace of life that nourishes the natural character of individuals, communities and the earth, in order to take what we believe to be the best path forward.

2.heading: Farm Integration
2.description: By concentrating on a small group of farms across our categories of management, we strive to support clearly defined goals centered on responsibility, sustainability, and long-term improvement.

3.heading: Market Development & Consumer Awareness
3.description: We leverage our team’s complementary entrepreneurial experience to explore direct-to-consumer channels, including CSA and other market-entry strategies that strengthen consumer connection and brand awareness.

4.heading: Regulatory & Policy Engagement
4.description: We actively monitor our farms’ regulatory obligations and play an essential role in the formulation and implementation of policies governing the worldwide agriculture industry through accountability, positions, and leadership.

partners.title: Backed by incredible partners
partners.description: We’re fortunate to be supported by partners who share our vision. Their backing helps us advance sustainable agriculture.
